changelog: Fix: SKILL.md frontmatter version had drifted (stuck at 0.2.0 while the registry advanced to 0.2.4); frontmatter now matches the registry version and will be bumped with every release. No behavioral change.
summary: Punch up your writing with actual wit — toasts, bios, birthday messages, Slack posts, presentation openers. Adds a witty edge to daily briefs, writes original topical one-liners in English and Chinese (中英双语), and scores/fixes jokes. Anti-cringe by design; it knows when NOT to be funny. Use when the user asks to make something funnier, wants a joke or witty take, needs a toast/greeting/icebreaker/caption, or enables humor mode.
